title: Settings
description: Appearance, language and where your files are kept.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how Lab Brain looks. System follows your device.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language used for menus, labels and messages.

dataFolder.title: Data folder
dataFolder.description: Where your attached files and database backups are kept. Choose a folder your cloud drive syncs, to have everything saved there.
dataFolder.none: No folder chosen yet. Files stay in the app's own storage folder and nothing is backed up.
dataFolder.managed: The server's owner fixed the storage folder, so it cannot be changed here.
dataFolder.pathHelp: Change it with the button, or type or paste the full path of an existing folder.
dataFolder.hasBackups: It also holds backups: after using it you can restore one below.
dataFolder.chooseTitle: What should happen to the files you have now?
dataFolder.modeMoveHint: The files your records use are copied and checked. The originals stay until you delete them.
dataFolder.modeUse: Use the folder as it is
dataFolder.modeUseHint: Files already attached open only if the folder holds them.

errors.empty: Type the path of a folder.
errors.notAbsolute: Type the full path, starting from the root of the drive.
errors.notFound: No folder exists at that path.
errors.notWritable: Lab Brain cannot write to that folder.
errors.collision: {path} is already in that folder, so nothing was changed.
errors.unverified: {path} could not be copied correctly, so nothing was changed.
errors.unavailable: The data folder cannot be changed here.
errors.backupFailed: The backup failed. Check that the folder is still reachable.
errors.restoreFailed: The backup could not be restored.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Copies of your records, made for you. Restore one if something goes wrong.
backups.empty: No backups in this folder yet.
backups.needsFolder: Choose a data folder to start backing up.
backups.restoreText: Your current data is replaced by the backup from {date} ({computer}). A copy of what you have now is kept on this computer first.

picker.title: Choose a folder
picker.description: Click through your folders and select the one to keep your files and backups in. Only folder names are listed.

errors.notAbsolute: That is not a full path.
errors.invalidName: That name cannot be used for a folder.
errors.exists: A folder with that name already exists.
errors.cannotCreate: The folder could not be created.

moreInfo.files: Your attached files (spectra, images, PDFs) are saved in a folder named Lab Brain, created inside the folder you choose, in a subfolder named files.
moreInfo.backups: A copy of your records (projects, samples, values) is saved in Lab Brain, in a subfolder named backups, every 10 minutes while something changed. The last 30 are kept.
moreInfo.database: The live database stays on this computer, not in the folder. A cloud drive can damage a database that is open, so only backups of it go in the folder.
moreInfo.restore: On a new computer, choose the same folder and restore a backup to get your records back.
moreInfo.oneComputer: Use the folder from one computer at a time.
moreInfo.privacy: Everyone who can open the folder can read your files and backups.

dataFolder.willUse: Files and backups will go in:
dataFolder.alreadyThere: A Lab Brain folder is already there, and nothing in it is replaced.

exampleData.title: Example data
exampleData.description: The demo's example project, with experiments, samples and measurements. Removing it deletes only the example projects, and you can add it back.
exampleData.alreadyThere: The example data is already there
exampleData.removeText: The example projects are deleted with everything in them. Your own projects are not touched.
